player_prompt.intro: Umdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-HighSociety (inguqulo yabadlali ababili). Ukuhamba komdlalo: Amakhadi ayishumi adumile athengiswa ngokulandelana. Ukunikela: Kuwo wonke amadili, khetha ngasese ikhadi lemali 1-11 bese uveza. • Ukunikela okuphezulu kunqoba ikhadi lodumo bese ulahla lelo khadi lemali. • Ukunikela okuphansi kugcina ikhadi labo lemali. • Tie -> zombili izinhlinzeko zibuyiselwa futhi ikhadi lodumo elifanayo liphinde lithengiswe. Ukushaya amagoli: Ngemuva kwawo wonke amadili ayishumi, engeza ** imali esele + amaphuzu odumo **. * Inani eliphakeme * liwina (ukuqopha ngqo ->). ** Isenzo ** syntax → ** thenga ikhadi elilodwa elifana ne-'[7] 'noma'[11] '.
